sources.entry: Rilmazafone - Design DMG installers on a WYSIWYG canvas and build exactly what you drew, no scripts. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/kageroumado/rilmazafone) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6790960011?platform=mac)

summary.name: Rilmazafone
summary.one_liner: Rilmazafone is a macOS app for designing DMG disk image installers on a WYSIWYG canvas and building a signed .dmg in one click.
use_cases: arrange app icons on a disk image background
build a signed macOS disk image for distribution
make a styled background with text and SF Symbols for a DMG
choose compression format for a disk image
summary.what_it_does: The app provides a canvas that matches Finder's window, where icons can be placed with guides for centers, thirds and neighboring items. Backgrounds can be built from layered images, gradients or solid colors, with color adjustments, vignette and bloom. Variable blur uses linear or radial masks shown live on the canvas. Styled text and SF Symbols can be rendered into the background, and per-icon frosted panels with shadow, bevel and blend modes help keep labels readable. The build step outputs UDZO, UDBZ, LZFSE or LZMA compressed images in HFS+ or APFS and signs them with an identity from the user's keychain.
notable: Canvas matches Finder's window so the layout is WYSIWYG, building exactly what was drawn without scripts
Builds and signs DMG files using an identity from the keychain
Supports UDZO, UDBZ, LZFSE and LZMA compression and HFS+ or APFS filesystems
caveats: Requires macOS Tahoe 26 according to the page
Listings disagree on licensing: the page says MIT open source, while awesome-mac lists it as freeware, and an App Store link is provided
